# 111 Main Street

<!-- Generated by examples/woodmont-portfolio/build.ts from 111-main-street/facts.json. Edit the JSON and rebuild. -->

**Type:** Class A warehouse distribution building (industrial, rear-load)  
**Location:** South Amboy, Middlesex County, NJ: Broadway/Main Street redevelopment zone

A 152,100 SF, 36-foot-clear warehouse on a 22-acre site by Woodmont Industrial Partners (with Jingoli), started in May 2022 and delivered with a 96,000 SF lease in January 2026; 25 docks, 23 knockout panels, two drive-ins and a 26-space trailer lot.

## Estimates

Each of these is a modelling assumption, not a published number.

| Assumption | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| End column bays | 51 ft | **Estimate.** 780 ft = 12 typical 56'6" bays + two end bays of 51 ft; the real end bays are not published. |
| Wall height above the warehouse floor | 12.5 m | **Estimate.** 41 ft: the published 36 ft clear plus about 5 ft of roof structure. |
| Dock-high floor above the truck court | 1.22 m | **Estimate.** 48 in, the usual dock height; the whole building sits on this datum. Ramps to the drive-in doors are not modelled. |
| Dock door size | 9 x 10 ft | **Estimate.** Common dock door size; not published. |
| Drive-in door size | 12 x 14 ft | **Estimate.** Common drive-in size; not published. |
| Dock door spacing | 13 ft | **Estimate.** Centre-to-centre; the 25 docks and 2 drive-ins are set as one run centred on the dock wall. Knockout panels are listed, not modelled. |
| Truck court depth | 130 ft | **Estimate.** Not published for this building; the 130 ft that Woodmont publishes for Alpha 78 is used. |
| Trailer stall size | 12 x 55 ft | **Estimate.** Typical trailer stall; the 26 stalls are laid in one row past the truck court. |
| Car parking spaces | 83 spaces | **Estimate.** The building total is not published ("ample car parking"). The brochure gives 30 striped spaces for the 55,250 SF space; scaled to 152,100 SF that is about 83. |
| Car parking layout | 9 x 18 ft stalls on a 24 ft aisle, one double-loaded bay along the front wall | **Estimate.** Typical layout; position on the side opposite the docks is an estimate. |
| Site outline | rectangle of the published 22 acres, the building centred along its long side | **Estimate.** No parcel geometry or aerial image was reachable from the build environment, so the outline, the building's position on it and its orientation (docks facing plan south, +z) are schematic. The rectangle leaves at least 30 m around the modelled layout (building, courts, trailer rows, car fields); areas and counts are the published ones. |
| Which end the available space is | east end | **Estimate.** Not published; the 283'-4" available space is put at the plan-east end and the rest of the building is the leased space. |
| Column size | 0.3 m | **Estimate.** 12 in square steel column; not published. |
| Exterior wall thickness | 0.3 m | **Estimate.** Tilt-up concrete panels are typically 9-12 in; not published. |

## Conflicts and notes

- NJBIZ (May 2022, at groundbreaking) gave 22 dock doors and 22 knock-outs; Real Estate NJ (January 2026, at delivery) and Woodmont's site give 25 docks and 23 knockouts. The delivered numbers are used.
- Woodmont's site gives both 152,100 SF and "a 152,000 SF warehouse"; 152,100 SF (also the leasing site and Real Estate NJ) is used.
- The leasing site's dock and parking counts (8 docks with 8 knockouts, 1 drive-in, 30 striped spaces) describe the 55,250 SF available space only, not the building.
- The 780 ft length leaves the leased space at 780 - 283.33 = 496.67 ft, about 96,850 SF against the published 96,000 SF lease; the difference (about 850 SF) is not explained by the sources.
- No street number is published beyond "111 Main St."; the scene carries no geocode.
